policy: source is O14 five actual JPA entity classes, columns verified individually from @Column/@JoinColumn source; target is a recommended physical/schema compatibility mapping, not migrations
notes: O14 @javax.persistence annotations are code-level source proof only; modern Jakarta JPA requires real retest and likely annotation/package adaptation.
Source Resource.type and Allocation.borrower_name are preserved as physical columns. Public v2 may name its JSON fields kind and borrowerNameSnapshot.
Legacy phone_number plaintext field is not allowed as a live DB persistence strategy; service DTO compatibility must be separated from ORM mapping and authenticated encryption.
Other original physical names preserved, but org_id, public_id, version and new relationship/ledger columns are added.
Modern DB must be created fresh with migrations; source reference DB not silently imported.
